title: Shop voice payment consent result
description: Structured result after the owner confirms or refuses paying a vendor for a known order amount. No bank secrets.

payment_consent_completed.description: True when the consent question was answered clearly.

owner_approved_payment.description: True only when the owner explicitly approved paying this exact amount.

order_id.description: Ledger order this payment applies to.

amount.description: Exact amount the owner approved or refused.

vendor_display_name.description: Spoken vendor name for audit; must match a saved vendor.

owner_notes.description: Optional free-text; must not contain account numbers, PINs, or OTPs.
